title: generalcodes
summary: A personal collection of Python scripts combining data profiling (ydata-profiling), PII detection (Presidio), and an AutoGen-based agent pipeline for automated data validation, all built around synthetic data generation. SDV's single-table (CTGAN, GaussianCopula) and multi-table (HMA) synthesizers, metadata schemas, and evaluate_quality reporting are directly instantiated and run across multiple scripts.
evidence: autogen-sinthesizevalidate.py:151-152 selects and instantiates GaussianCopulaSynthesizer/CTGANSynthesizer; sdv-multitable-deepseek.py:106 synthesizer.fit(...) with HMASynthesizer
